headline: BTC stalls below $80k as liquidity hunt intensifies, altcoins rally on fresh momentum
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC is testing a descending channel lower‑boundary, holding above the 78.8k liquidity pool; the 4H view shows a flat range between 78.8k support and 80k resistance, suggesting a pending breakout or retest.
altcoin_summary: Capital is rotating into high‑beta alts, with SOPH, IOST, INJ and WLD leading gains, reflecting risk‑on sentiment as Bitcoin steadies.
strategy_outlook: Spot: add to positions on pullbacks near 78.8k with stops just below; Futures: stay flat or hedge short until a decisive close above 80k confirms a breakout.
